message: The other day, I found myself feeling a bit smug when I noticed my go-bag sitting by the front door, ready for anything. Just last week, I had a moment of panic when a storm warning came through, and I couldn't help but think, 'Well, I told myself to be prepared!' 😌 It’s those little reminders that keeping a few essentials handy really pays off.
